text:
maya: hey — hunting down logs for a customer report. i have trace_id=ab12cd34ef and an x-request-id=req-9f8e7d; where should i look to pull the raw request lines (edge -> proxy -> pod)?

jonah: quick path i use: 1) trace search in Console to find span links, 2) grab the span/edge id and grep the proxy logs, 3) stern or kubectl logs for the pod. usually takes <2 mins.

rachel: +1. also check the request-ref header -- LB and edge sometimes rewrite x-request-id. in Console: Observability > Traces, paste trace_id, open the root span and click "related logs".

maya: do you have the exact commands? i'm on my laptop and want to run from cli.

jonah: sure. if you know pod/service name:
```bash
stern -n prod 'svc-auth|svc-proxy' --since 10m | rg "req-9f8e7d" -n
```
that finds lines across replicas. if you only have trace id, use the trace link in console to get the span id, then grep for span id (eg span.ab12cd34ef).

jonah: alternative if console hides fields:
```bash
# get last 30m proxy logs from ELK via our curl helper
./bin/logs-query "service:edge-proxy AND trace.id:ab12cd34ef" --env prod --tail 200
```

rachel: note: ingress strips the header for some older deploys. try both x-request-id and request-ref when grepping. also check the edge proxy's JSON field names: we log `req_id` in v2.

maya: ran stern but nothing for req-9f8e7d. i do see spans in Console, root span has tag `x_req=req-9f8e7d` though.

jonah: if stern returns nothing, it's either older than --since or logs shipped to ELK/Longterm. increase --since to 60m or run logs-query. also confirm you're in prod namespace.

maya: ok bumped to 60m and found a couple of lines in proxy with span.ab12cd34ef. grabbing them now.

ops-bot: heads-up — log-shipper reported a lag for prod for ~5m at 2024-04-02T12:34:00Z, some late logs may arrive after a delay.

rachel: if you need raw request payloads (body), remember we only retain bodies for 7d and they may be redacted; open a ticket if you need longer retention.

maya: thanks everyone — got the raw lines and the payload (redacted but enough). saved snippets to #tickets/1234.

jonah: nice. for future: i keep a tiny cheatsheet in ~/notes/observability.md with the 1-liners (stern, logs-query, console trace path). happy to add you if it's helpful.

maya: please add — also adding a short howto to our runbook so on-call can triage faster. :thumbsup:

rachel: cool. if you want, i can add the exact grep patterns we use for the proxy (handles both req_id and x-request-id).

maya: that'd be great, thx!"
